title: Secondary clarifier sludge withdrawal worked calculation (10 MLD, 0.6 RAS)
readable: volume to be drawn = 10000×0.6 = 6000 m3/day; continuous withdrawal = 6000/24 = 250 m3/hr; area for 1.5 m/s = 250/3600/1.5 = 0.046 m2 giving a dia of 0.25 m; sump area for 2 m dia = 3.14 m2; resulting volume = 4.5×3.14 = 14.13 m3; HRT = 14.13/250 = 0.056 hrs or 3.4 minutes; volume for 10 minutes HRT = 250×10/60 = 42 m3; required diameter 3.5 m

symbols.definition: STP capacity, m3/day, for the printed 10 MLD
RAS ratio as printed in the heading (0.6 RAS)
height from invert of pipe to top of the clarifier, m
area, m2, of a 2 m minimum diameter sump, printed as 3.14

applicability: Worked example of sludge withdrawal from a secondary clarifier for a 10 MLD plant with 0.6 RAS, comparing direct pumping with a sludge sump.
notes: Printed inline as a sequence of prose calculations, not as displayed or numbered equations; p359-2 is a service locator.
The heading is printed as "Secondary Clarifier for 10 MLD of Sewage with 0.6 RAS".
The sump area is printed as 3.14 m2 for a minimum diameter of 2 m for man entry when needed.
HRT in the sump is printed as 0.056 hrs or 3.4 minutes; any sump has to be minimum 10 minutes of HRT.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs, plus enlarged crops at 288-720 dpi and a contact sheet of every hashed source region; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
